question.text: Which of the following mixtures act(s) as buffer solution?

solution.text:
Hint : (B) \(\mathrm{NH}_4 \mathrm{OH}+\mathrm{HCl}~(2: 1 \text { mole ratio}) \rightarrow \underset{\large 1 \quad:\quad 1 \atop 
\large \text{Buffer} \quad \text{buffer}}{\mathrm{NH}_4 \mathrm{Cl}+\mathrm{NH}_4 \mathrm{OH}}\)
(C) \(\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{COOH}+\mathrm{NaOH}(2: 1\) mole ratio \() \rightarrow \underset{\large 1\quad : \quad 1 \atop \large \text{Acidic buffer}}{\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{COONa}+\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{COOH}}\)
